pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [93, 790, 155, 993] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they are walking parallel to it along the sidewalk, showing no signs of turning toward the road or stopping to assess traffic, while maintaining a steady pace in their current direction.
